Flying Pig: original preserved at `public/samples/sample-pattern.jpg` (SHA-256 dd4adc3fd44257baf020725055e56371749d97259bf26f1c9ab08ef76be49a61).

Duck and Pink Teapot: inline references were visible in chat, but no downloadable original file/attachment IDs were exposed. Originals are pending. Do not substitute screenshots of the inline rendering, re-encode a reconstruction, or mark these fixtures tested.

When originals are available, copy their exact bytes here, record original filename and SHA-256, and run `node tests/diagnose-mard.mjs <original-path> [other-paths...]`.

References (evaluation only): Pig 40×51, 1179, 5 colors; Duck 50×50, 139, 8 colors; Teapot 50×50, 1333, 6 colors. Production detection does not use these values.
